author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
To all the AI startups, you have to publish your demo out in the public so I can see what it really is.   Don't ask me to contact you to ask for a demo.  Stop wasting my time.

If you really want me to contact you, setup a MCP server, so my AI agent can contact your AI agent on my behalf.

If you jealously guarding your idea, thinking someone will copy it away when they see your demo, then you have a real problem.  Your product has no moat.
